fields.name: count
fields.desc: number of records

desc: Dark Assembly bills ("wishes", 議題): 164 rows. Name/description, difficulty, Mana cost, approval bias and a flag program: listed if req_flags ON and block_flags OFF; on passing set_flags are turned ON and clear_flags OFF. Effects without flags (stat/item bills, party bills 201..243) are hard-coded by id. No bill creates/unlocks characters or classes directly (only party relation bills 201..243).

fields.name: id
fields.desc: bill id: 1..28 utility (names/colours/reincarnate/subclass), 31..72 misc, 101..128 temporary effects, 201..243 party-relation bills (200+senator party), 302..318 unlocks, 401..411 new maps, 1001..1048 item bills

fields.name: difficulty
fields.desc: 0..5; 0 for menu-like bills (no vote), 5 for the hardest (strategy/MOV/range)

fields.name: mana_cost
fields.desc: Mana cost (e.g. Martial Training 1000/5000/10000/50000/100000; Raise Max Item Level 9999999)

fields.name: vote_modifier
fields.desc: -100..100: approval bias (10 typical; -100 "Will surely be denied" / strategy bills; negative for strong bills)

fields.name: unk_038
fields.desc: 0; 20 for item ability bills 1041..1047; 500 for Raise Max Item Level (max passes / increment?)

fields.name: unk_03C
fields.desc: 1 mostly; 5/25/50 Pleinair, 6/12/25/50/100 Martial Training, 100 map bills, 10/1000/100000 item stat bills (required level/rank?)
